title: Personal Credit Cards: Automatic Payment Instructions
content:
Personal Credit Cards may be paid automatically from a Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account. An automatic payment instruction names the checking account that pays the card and the kind of amount taken; the debit falls on each payment due date.

## What an instruction may take

| Kind of instruction | Amount debited on each due date |
|---|---|
| Minimum payment due | the minimum payment shown on the statement |
| Statement balance | the full statement balance |
| Fixed amount | the chosen fixed sum, capped at the statement balance |
| No instruction | nothing is debited automatically |

## Paying account

The checking account named to pay the card must belong to the same customer as the card and must be in active status, as the bank's checking records show for that account at the time the instruction is set.

## Who gives the instruction

Setting up or changing an automatic payment is the cardholder's own instruction. A cancellation takes effect for due dates falling at least 3 calendar days after the day the change is recorded.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical dates)

- A cardholder cancels on the 10th of a month and the next due date is the 12th. The 12th is only 2 calendar days away, short of the lead time, so the cancellation does not reach that due date; it does reach the one after.
- A cardholder cancels on the 10th and the due date is the 13th, exactly 3 calendar days later; the cancellation already covers it.
- A fixed instruction of 400.00 USD against a statement balance of 260.00 USD takes 260.00 USD, because a fixed amount never exceeds the statement balance.
